title: Fee-on-transfer / rebasing token incompatibility across Silo and convert accounting is gated by privileged whitelist (latent, not permissionlessly reachable)
description: Several non-Silo token sinks use argument-based accounting and/or raw (non-SafeERC20) transfers that would mis-account for fee-on-transfer or rebasing tokens: UnripeFacet.addMigratedUnderlying (incrementUnderlying(amount) on the argument; owner-only), LibPipelineConvert.executePipelineConvert (IERC20(inputToken).transfer(C.PIPELINE, fromAmount) raw, then re-measures via transferTokensFromPipeline so the convert leg is partially balance-checked), LibWellConvert (C.bean().transfer raw), LibFlood/LibFertilizer raw approve. None of these tracks a balanceOf delta for the credited amount. However, every token that can flow through these paths is constrained to the governance-managed whitelist / unripe-underlying / Barn-Raise set, and whitelistToken/whitelistTokenWithEncodeType/whitelistTokenWithExternalImplementation are owner-or-Beanstalk gated. The current set (BEAN, BEAN-LP wells, WETH, wstETH) is entirely standard, non-FOT and non-rebasing, so the FOT/rebasing drain class is not reachable by an unprivileged attacker in this deployment. Recorded as Info to flag the latent assumption rather than an exploitable bug.
impact: No present impact: requires a privileged whitelist/underlying/barn-raise change to introduce an FOT or rebasing token. Documents the systemic 'records argument, not received amount' assumption that holds protocol-wide outside SiloFacet.deposit.

ite.intent: Ensure protocol-wide token accounting matches delivered amounts for any handled token
ite.technique: Argument-based credit + raw ERC20 calls assume standard transfer semantics
ite.evasion: Privileged whitelist is the only entry for a non-standard token; standard tokens give no drift

ice_chain.corrupted_state: balanceOfUnderlying / convert BDV / recapitalization for an FOT or rebasing token
ice_chain.impact: Accounting drift / potential withdraw underflow only after a non-standard token is privileged-whitelisted
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibUnripe / LibConvert / Silo withdraw read the underlying and BDV totals
ice_chain.exploit_path: owner whitelists FOT token -> users deposit/convert -> recorded > received -> later withdrawals drain residual; blocked today by token set + privileged gate
